evals.name: small-copy
evals.prompt: Prépare un plan très court pour corriger Sauvgarder en Sauvegarder dans src/copy.js. Ne change rien pour le moment.
evals.expected_output: A short grounded plan, no unnecessary questions, no synthetic TDD, approval then delivery handoff.
expectations: The proposed change targets src/copy.js and the exact misspelling without unrelated work.
The plan is at most 300 words and asks no product/setup questions beyond approval.
No new test suite or forced TDD is proposed for this copy-only change.
The plan preserves approval before edits and names the downstream delivery owner.

evals.name: ui-no-runtime
evals.prompt: Planifie une amélioration du graphe : je veux mieux repérer les petits nœuds et lire leurs labels. Garde la structure actuelle.
evals.expected_output: Read rendering facts, distinguish proposals, select better-ui and behavioral TDD, honor disabled launch, plan visual checks honestly.
expectations: The plan grounds diagnosis in at least two fixture facts: zoom-scaled radius, degree threshold, label size/alpha, separate pointer hit area.
Proposed sizes/thresholds are labeled proposals rather than visually verified conclusions.
Launch disabled is honored and no screenshots or running-app verification are fabricated.
Behavioral tests and rendered readability/interaction checks are distinguished; selected expertise has a phase and assignment.

evals.name: linear-conflict
evals.prompt: Planifie APP-42 dans Linear. Lis bien les sous-tickets et propose comment le faire.
evals.expected_output: Read all scoped provider fixture records; identify parent/child role conflict; ask focused decision, include CSV/error/audit coverage.
expectations: Evidence shows intake of APP-42, APP-10, APP-43, APP-44 and APP-9.
The admin-only vs all-members conflict is explicit and not silently decided from recency alone.
A focused role-policy question is present without an unrelated generic questionnaire.
The approach includes tenant isolation, CSV escaping and the audit requirement with suitable behavioral tests.

evals.name: missing-ui-skill
evals.prompt: Planifie une nouvelle page de paramètres avec une direction visuelle claire. Pour ce cas le skill design-frontend-dev est indisponible. Aucun serveur ni navigateur. Pas de maquette fournie.
evals.expected_output: Disclose missing expertise, no install/search, explicit limited design proposal/preview, do not claim visual validation or block independent planning.
expectations: The missing design skill is disclosed and no marketplace search, installation or invented invocation is claimed.
A limited design proposal or wireframe is offered for approval without pretending it is a rendered screenshot.
Missing browser/server does not block all planning or trigger unauthorized setup.
Assumptions and remaining visual verification are explicit.

evals.name: wrong-owner
evals.prompt: Le code est déjà prêt. Ouvre la PR et vérifie la CI, pas besoin de refaire un plan.
evals.expected_output: Route directly to ship-pr-dev without imposing planning approval; simulated handoff only in eval.
expectations: The response routes to ship-pr-dev without writing a new feature implementation plan.
It does not require planning approval or setup as a prerequisite for this standalone delivery request.
It names appropriate verification/review/CI work without claiming those actions have already succeeded.

evals.name: approved-resume
evals.prompt: Reprends approved-plan.md : je l’ai déjà approuvé. Dis-moi la suite concrète en gardant la contrainte local-only.
evals.expected_output: Honor approval and completed work, inspect current state, vertical TDD remaining scope and local-only Ship handoff. No redundant approval.
expectations: The response preserves existing approval and does not ask the same approval again.
It identifies completed tenant isolation and plans only remaining admin/CSV behavior plus verification.
Remaining testable behavior uses failing-test then implementation vertical slices.
The local-only constraint survives the handoff; no push, PR creation or remote CI success is promised.

evals.name: setup
evals.prompt: Configure ce workflow pour ce dépôt : Linear pour APP-*, ne lance jamais les applications par défaut. Les commandes de test sont déjà dans package.json. Je veux une config partagée.
evals.expected_output: Prepare portable shared planning+validation docs preserving preferences with links, no secrets, no marketplace search or task-specific rules.
expectations: Shared planning and validation configuration is produced or concretely specified, with Linear APP-* and launch disabled.
The configuration references existing package scripts instead of inventing service commands.
Shared configuration contains no credentials, absolute machine paths or unrelated task scenarios.
The response does not reopen answered tracker/launch preferences or add runtime marketplace discovery.
